name: foawr
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Foawr are giants of Manx folklore. They dwelled at sea and hurled boulders at sailors who came near. Some believe the foawr trace to the Fomorians, a people of Irish legend.

okr.objective: Foawr are Manx sea giants who harried sailors.
